package.name: claude-skills-clean
package.purpose: Clean skill-only distribution: native skill folders with their SKILL.md, references, scripts, assets, examples, and expected outputs.

kept: README.md and supporting files inside skill folders

how_to_locate_a_skill.step_1: Read summary.categories to choose the broad domain.
how_to_locate_a_skill.step_2: Open by_category.<category> and compare the user request with each description.
how_to_locate_a_skill.step_3: Read the selected skill_file first. Do not load every file in the package.
how_to_locate_a_skill.step_4: If SKILL.md refers to references, scripts, assets, or expected outputs, load only the needed files from the same skill folder.
how_to_locate_a_skill.step_5: If no exact match exists, use the closest category_bundle SKILL.md for routing guidance, then ask one targeted clarification only if necessary.
